description: A retained suffix dependency keeps enclosing answers out of the shared memo (engine §4.3).
grammar:
%rule text $x:body
%conditions $x.parse(… driver), $x.parse(wrap), $x.parse(plain)
%rule body "a"
%rule driver $x:body
%conditions $x.without-elision.parse(tail)
%rule wrap $x:body
%conditions $x.parse(… driver)
%rule tail "a"
%rule plain "a"
